Review 086 (NO-SHIP), all three to fix:
MAJOR 1, apps/web/src/game-state.ts:322: FR-24 says the result closes at the player's next move, but a tutor_attempt that arrives after the next move still opens the pop-up and starts a new 5 s timer. The server emits tutor_attempt only after `await botTurn` and two analyses (apps/server/src/games.ts:1095-1118), so the player can move first. The `known` check accepts it because leavePanel keeps the question id in `left`. Fix: drop a tutor_attempt (and do not start the timer) once a later player move has been attempted. E.g. check that event.move.uci is the player's latest move in state.game.moves and no newer move is pending (pendingFen / tutorBeforeMove), or record the try's ply. Your choice; the question must still close as before (only the pop-up is suppressed). A late tutor_reveal for that question must not open anything either.
Reviewer repro: game_started(q1) -> move_attempted g1f3 -> move_accepted -> bot_move e6 -> move_attempted c1f4 -> tutor_attempt q1 Nf3 wrong -> tutor_reveal Bf4 => tryResult is set; expected null.
MAJOR 2, apps/web/src/styles.css:88: at phone width the toast wraps to two lines (~45 px) while the Bot row plus gap is ~29.6 px, so it covers the top of rank 8. Measured (Playwright, real styles.css): 320 px with 'Nf3, correct. Only 0.1 off the best move' and 360 px with '... Less than 0.1 off the best move' overlap; 375-412 ok. Fix so no text overlaps at 320-412 px (e.g. single line with nowrap + ellipsis plus a smaller font at narrow widths, or reserve the height above the board without moving the board when it appears/disappears). The full text must stay available to screen readers (aria-live region text not truncated).
Verify layout with Playwright at 320, 360, 375, 390, 412 px for the longest texts. A layout check in apps/web/e2e is welcome if it can render the toast without a tutor (e.g. a test-only route is NOT allowed; a component-level check in vitest with computed widths is fine if feasible); otherwise measure in a scratch script and paste the numbers in your return.
MINOR: add the slow-path order test (tutor_attempt after the next move_attempted) to apps/web/test/try-toast.test.ts.
Accepted from round 1, keep: 'Less than 0.1 off the best move' for 1-4 cp; no e2e of a graded try.
